docs.question: How many minutes in total have outer-zone stations been full?
docs.answer: Outer-zone stations have been full (open with no free docks) for a total of about 165 minutes across the observed period.
docs.sql: SELECT SUM(full_minutes) AS total_full_minutes FROM marts.mart_station_kpis WHERE zone = 'outer' LIMIT 200

docs.question: What percentage of all docks are in the inner zone?
docs.answer: The inner zone holds 66.9% of all docks — 2,460 of the 3,677 docks across the network.
docs.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN zone = 'inner' THEN capacity ELSE 0 END) / SUM(capacity), 1) AS inner_dock_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN zone = 'inner' THEN capacity ELSE 0 END) AS inner_docks, SUM(capacity) AS total_docks FROM marts.dim_station LIMIT 200
